body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and suppress 1 point of its equipment Fortitude bonus until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: An adjacent willing ally ignores the target's movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Breaker
rider.html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to end one ordinary defensive benefit on the target. This cannot remove a Specialty Condition, an item or a Wound.
